articleTitle: ‘6-7 police stations called me’: Mumbai, Nagpur CJP members allege pressure
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Protesters stage a protest under the leadership of CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke, seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter roll deletions at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Park, Dadar, in Mumbai on Friday. (ANI Photo)
description: Plainclothes police noted names at a Mumbai meet and visited homes in Nagpur, members allege, ahead of the Jantar Mantar protest seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Police say they are "doing our job".
body_raw: Even as Cockroach Janta Party CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on Tuesday accused the Chandrapur police of serving notices on party workers to keep them away from the partys Delhi protest, members in Mumbai and Nagpur alleged similar pressure. In Mumbai, members said plainclothes police noted names at a party meeting and warned of FIRs. The partys city coordinator said six or seven police stations had called him. In Nagpur, a coordinator said police came to his home. The CJP has called the protest at Delhis Jantar Mantar on October 10 to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Dipke announced it after a rally at Mumbais Shivaji Park on October 2. On September 23, The Indian Express had published an investigation on the rupture within the Election Commission, with two Election Commissioners Vivek Joshi and Sukhbir Singh Sandhu flagging 14 objections in 10 months on issues that strike right at the heart of the electoral process. At a press conference in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Dipke had alleged that the Chandrapur notices asked workers not to join the protest, and that police questioned them on how they would pay for the trip. He called this dictatorship and asked how police could already say, as the notices did, that the agitation would turn violent. In Mumbai, CJP member Mayur Sharma said police in plain clothes came to the partys meeting at Sana Banquet Hall in Dongri on Wednesday. We had a meeting at the Banquet hall, and the police had arrived in plain clothes and noted the names of the people present in the meeting. They showed us Dipkes post in which he had posted the notice. 7-8 police officers in plain clothes threatened us with an FIR if we attend the protest, which is scheduled to be on October 10 at Jantar Mantar, he told this newspaper. Pranay Ahire, the CJPs Mumbai coordinator, told The Indian Express I have received a call from 6-7 police stations asking what my plans for the 10th of October are. I have not revealed my plan for that day. This is very sad that they are tracking our movements. Another member, Azzaruddin, said he was told a notice would be served on him. Many comrades have received calls or threats that notice will be served if we are planning to attend the protest. I received an ultimatum too, he said. In Nagpur, CJP west zone coordinator Durgesh Kuhike told The Indian Express that police visited his home and asked how many people from the city were likely to travel to Jantar Mantar. CJP volunteers alleged that officials also indirectly sought the numbers and identities of those planning to join. Samya Korde, a Bombay High Court advocate and member of the Shetkari Kamgar Paksh, said police may have identified protesters from records of protests in July. Many of us had attended protests in July. Some of us might have been detained, some of us came under surveillance and FIRs were registered in July. Based on that they might have tracked down protesters. Calling regular citizens is completely unconstitutional. If they are doing that it should be stopped, Korde said. Asked about the allegations, a police official said, We are doing our job.

articleTitle: Cramped spaces, deposit disputes: Delhi students tell cops what’s wrong with their PGs
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Police interact with students at a PG in Delhi. (Express Photo)
description: Students in Delhi’s major PG hubs raised concerns during a police outreach drive after the Satya Niketan hostel collapse.
body_raw: Tushar wants to leave his paying guest accommodation in East Delhis Laxmi Nagar after seven months of living there and move in with a friend. But the second-year Delhi University student is worried he will have to forgo the Rs 20,000 security deposit he paid when he moved in. His rent agreement has an 11-month lock-in clause. My warden says that if I leave the PG before the lapse of 11 months, my Rs 20,000 security deposit will not be returned. Im not sure how to deal with this, said Tushar, a B.Com student from Uttar Pradesh. His concern was among several issues raised during a Delhi Police drive to meet students living in PGs and rented accommodation in the Capitals major student hubs - Mukherjee Nagar in North Delhi, Laxmi Nagar in East Delhi, Rajinder Nagar, Karol Bagh and Patel Nagar in Central Delhi. The drive, undertaken by police teams from every police station, followed the September 6 collapse of a building housing a private hostel in Satya Niketan, which claimed seven lives, including those of five students. Waterlogging, wires and poor maintenance Thousands of students who flock to Delhi to study in colleges and coaching institutes live in PGs because of the acute shortage of on-campus accommodation. Kuldeep, who studies at a coaching institute in Karol Bagh and stays in a nearby PG, said, For most students, security deposit is the most common problem because people sometimes have to leave or change their PGs, he said. Cramped spaces in many private hostels have also been worrying, Kuldeep said. But the Satya Niketan incident has made students more worried about safety and accountability. Its cramped inside the PGs. But what is bothering us most after this incident is the question of who is accountable to us, he said. Muskan, who has been living at a PG in Old Rajinder Nagar for over a year, said her concerns revolved around basic standards of living poor hygiene, inadequate water supply and electricity maintenance, sagging electrical wires and waterlogging her PG. After meeting students at PGs, reading rooms and libraries in these student hubs, police compiled the issues raised by students and prepared an Action Taken Report ATR, which was submitted to the Delhi Police Headquarters, according to the officials sources. Officers said the most frequent grievance aired by students in these interactions was over security deposits. Apart from these, students also flagged waterlogging, seepage, cleanliness in kitchens, maintenance of the buildings, and dark or poorly lit stretches around PGs. Rohit Rajbir Singh, DCP Central, said police were briefing PG owners and property dealers about the issue of security deposits, which he said was a major concern for students who spend considerable amounts on accommodation. Letters were sent to civic agencies seeking structural audits of properties for the safety and security of students. The Delhi Fire Services was approached for fire-safety surveys. Libraries were directed to follow safety norms, obtain fire no-objection certificates and install CCTV cameras, Singh added. Police also began regular engagement with Residents Welfare Associations to improve CCTV coverage and ensure that PGs and rented accommodation followed safety guidelines, he said. Steve, a B.Com student living in Mukherjee Nagar, said that police had also shared contact numbers with them during their interaction at his PG. The police officers had come to my PG a few days ago and told us about precautionary measures in case an emergency situation arises. They also gave us the contact number of the station house officer, he said. The officer also told us to take precautions to prevent incidents of mobile phone snatching. He also told us to not befriend strangers, Rudra said.

articleTitle: Anushka Sharma, parents buy Rs 25.8 cr flats in same building; own Rs 44.1 cr property in Mumbai
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Anshima, Ajay Kumar Sharma and Anushka Sharma
description: Anushka Sharma and her parents, Ashima and Ajay Kumar Sharma, have bought two adjoining apartments in Mumbai’s Versova for a combined Rs 25.80 crore.
body_raw: Anushka Sharma and her parents, Ashima and Ajay Kumar Sharma, have purchased two adjoining apartments in Mumbais Versova for a combined Rs 25.80 crore. According to registered agreements for sale accessed by real estate data analytics firm CRE Matrix, both transactions were registered on July 8, 2026.The apartments are part of Godrej Skyshore, a luxury residential project by Godrej Properties. Since the project is still under construction, possession of both apartments is expected on or before June 30, 2031. The payment schedule is linked to the progress of construction. Anushka Sharma, family now own 3 flats on same floor Anushka Sharma has purchased a 2,153 sq ft apartment in the project for Rs 14.89 crore. She paid a stamp duty of Rs 74.47 lakh for the transaction. The apartment comes with three covered basement parking spaces. On the same day, Anushkas parents purchased the adjoining apartment on the same floor. Their 1,577 sq ft apartment cost Rs 10.91 crore. They paid Rs 65.44 lakh as stamp duty and the apartment comes with two covered basement parking spaces. With these two purchases, Anushka and her family now own three apartments on the same floor at Godrej Skyshore. The combined value of the three properties is close to Rs 44 crore. Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma also own an apartment in the project Earlier in July, Anushka and her husband, Indian cricketer Virat Kohli, purchased a 2,644 sq ft apartment in the same project for Rs 18.29 crore. According to property registration documents accessed by Zapkey, the transaction was registered on July 21, 2026. The apartment comes with 316 sq ft of exclusive area and three car parking spaces. The couple paid Rs 1.09 crore as stamp duty and Rs 30,000 as registration fees. Based on the transaction value and carpet area, the deal works out to around Rs 69,159 per sq ft. Also Read Virat Kohli refutes claim he visited Premanand Ji Maharaj for Rs 5 cr Out of deep faith Tabu also bought a flat in Godrej Skyshore Anushka and Virat are not the only Bollywood celebrities to have invested in Godrej Skyshore. Actor Tabu, whose full name is Tabassum Fatima Hashmi, also purchased a 2,153 sq ft apartment in the same building in April 2026. Tabu reportedly bought the apartment for Rs 10 crore from Godrej Properties, according to property registration documents accessed by Liases Foras. The purchase came to light months before Anushka and Virats transaction in the same project. On the professional front, Tabus latest release is Drishyam The Conclusion whereas Anushka Sharmas last big screen appearance was Zero 2018 with Shah Rukh Khan and Katrina Kaif. Anushka has shifted base to London with her husband, Virat and two children, Vamika 5 and Akaay 2.

articleTitle: As PM Modi completes 25 years in office, key takeaways from his speech
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Narendra Modi 25 years, PM Modi speech, Modi 25 years in public life,
description: PM says he continues to be a learner and exhorts people to achieve the country’s dream of “Vikst Bharat” by 2047.
body_raw: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday completed 25 years in public life, having served as Gujarat Chief Minister from 2001 to 2014 and as Prime Minister since then. On the occasion, Modi asserted that the country had grown from strength to strength and exhorted people to ensure that the nation achieved its dream of becoming Viksit Bharat by 2047. Here are the key takeaways from the PMs speech. Here to stay Modi said he would not stop, get tired, or get diverted from his path until India became a developed country. We will do it, he repeatedly said in his speech, asserting that India would become a developed nation by 2047. 25 years of serving the people. I bow to 140 crore Indians for their trust and look forward to serving the nation with greater commitment in the times to come. - Narendra Modi narendramodi October 7, 2026 The assertion that he was willing to continue came amid speculation over the past year about whether the Prime Minister, who turned 76 on September 17, would gradually bow out of active politics. His remarks suggest he is looking to remain at the helm for a long time and that the job of building his political legacy is far from over. Peoples blessings at the core At a time when his government has been facing protests from Gen Z, Modi said the blessings of the people had been at the core of his political journey. When I became CM of Gujarat on October 7, 2001, I had not thought that this moment would come. Today, I have been consistently serving as head of the government for 25 years. This is a result of the blessings of the people, Modi said. I thank the BJP, NDA. and bow my head before the people of the country. So many elections happened in between, and the people always chose me to serve them. I bow before Indian democracy and the Constitution., he said. Today, I have prayed for 140 crore Indians and myself too. I prayed that God would give me the strength to serve my countrymen day and night. The biggest contribution to what I am today is that of the people of the country. They have been my biggest strength. The nation has given me everything, and so the biggest responsibility for the nation and its citizens is mine, the PM said. He said his accumulated political capital of 25 years belonged to the nation. Still learning Recalling that he was the first student to reach class in school in Vadnagar, Modi said, The hunger to learn became part of my life, and I still consider myself a student. Today, I prayed to God that my ability to learn should never diminish. He said, When I look back, I only feel gratitude. I feel gratitude to every person and event that taught me anything. Those who made me win made me humble. Those who made me fall taught me to stand up. Those who supported me showed me the power of faith, and those who opposed me taught me the strength of democracy, the PM said. He underlined, Today I can say that no event in my life was useless each taught me something. Modi mentioned the Bhuj earthquake, the Covid-19 pandemic and the medias portrayal of him as experiences he continued to remember. Acknowledging RSS Modi acknowledged the contribution of swayamsevaks, describing them as people who had served the country selflessly. I have got the support of countless Swayamsevaks in this journey, and I bow before them, he said. He added that the day was not only one to cherish memories, but also to say, We will do it. He reiterated Viksit Bharat by 2047. We will do it. None can stop a nation that brims with such self-confidence, Modi added. For me, 25 years is not about individual achievement. I spent my life in jungles and in mountains. I spent my life working for the organisation. Had I wanted to shine in electoral politics, I would have taken the plunge long ago. But my education taught me to live not for ambition but for the nation, Modi said. Karma is my Dharma. Karma is my worship for the country, Modi said, adding, In Gujarat, my mantra was Indias development through Gujarats development. But I had little experience all I had was faith in the people - something that became my strength. We did it in Gujarat the world is watching it. Post-2014 years The PM said that after 2014 his responsibilities grew and he faced multiple challenges. The economy was being described as a gone case, the PM said. A desperate country wanted new confidence, he said, adding that he told the country, We will do it. He said the picture had changed again and that Indias resilience, rather than policy paralysis, was now discussed when the country faced problems. Modi asserted that agricultural growth had broken all records over the past decade. He said people from all communities faced common difficulties and that the solutions should also be for all. All labharthis beneficiaries should benefit from saturation, he said. Revive Indias glory We have to revive Indias ancient glory, Modi said, adding that there was a time when India was synonymous with development. India showed the world the direction, but invaders burnt its universities and libraries, the PM said, adding that the countrys courage never collapsed even then. Swami Vivekananda had said that a great Bharat would rise one day, the PM said. He said Sri Aurobindo had also said that the sun of Indias destiny would rise one day and light the world. The PM said there should be a resolve to make India the greatest nation in the world. He said the whole world was discussing Indias pilot today, and that a day would come when the world would discuss a Made in India plane. We have problems but 140 crore solutions, he said, adding that this was a time to move forward with hard work. He recalled how India had thrown off the British yoke, adding that he was confident that India would become a developed nation by 2047. The PM also recalled how Article 370 was abrogated and how Naxalism and terrorism had been countered. Humne ghar mein ghus kar maara hai We have hit them in their homes, he said. Modi said it was important to decide today what had to be done to build a developed India by 2047, adding that India was moving in that direction. He said it was necessary to live and die for the country to become Viksit Bharat.

articleTitle: Forced bigamy, Gujarat woman’s bold escape, and a chilling ‘purification’
articleFeaturedImageAlt: ASP Bihani and her team had rescued the battered woman who had undergone a brutal, humiliating, public ordeal the previous day
description: Woman, lover forced to perform sexual acts in public, filmed while doing so; man claiming to be her husband among 9 arrested by Surendranagar Police
body_raw: When the police team entered the house in Surendranagar in Gujarats Saurashtra region, they saw a woman cooking at the stove. She seemed to be just another rural housewife, making lunch. But the officers knew she was not any woman-she was a woman whom they had seen in a horrific video that had been circulating in the area. As the woman turned toward them, the officers saw that the right side of her face and her right hand were swollen, and her eye was bruised. As soon as she saw us, she broke down in tears, and started to plead with us to take her away from there, Additional Superintendent of Police ASP Vedika Bihani told The Indian Express on Wednesday October 7. On Tuesday, ASP Bihani and her team had rescued the battered woman who had undergone a brutal, humiliating, public ordeal the previous day at the hands of a man who claimed to be her husband, and members of the mans extended family. Bihani and her team from the jurisdictional police station had managed to locate the woman less than an hour after Surendranagar Superintendent of Police SP Premsukh Delu received a call on October 6 morning from a community leader who told him about a certain video circulating on social media. The purported video, shot in a semi-rural locality of Surendranagar, showed an alleged purification ritual, in which a woman and her alleged lover were subjected to abject humiliation in public, SP Delu was told. The video had allegedly been shot around 9 am on October 5. Police said it showed nine persons, including two women, forcing the victimised woman and her alleged lover to engage in sexual acts while being tied with rope. The acts in the purported video included making the man lick the womans private parts, followed by making the woman urinate in a vessel and the man being forced to drink the urine, police said. All nine accused, including the man claiming to be the womans husband, have since been rounded up. Police officers said they had been booked under sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 BNS relating to gangrape, voluntarily causing hurt, and wrongful confinement, as well as sections of the Information Technology Act, 2000 IT Act. All the accused are members of the extended family of the man who has been claiming to be the husband of the woman, police said. Notably, police said that the prime accused in the case cannot be legally considered to be the husband of the victim, considering that he already had a wife and children in his home in Vapi city of Valsad when he married the victim. The complainant woman was married in a traditional manner to the main accused in this case, and had gone to live with him in Vapi. But she ran away from there, and came back to live with her lover, ASP Bihani told The Indian Express. However, Bihani said, the woman was sent back to Vapi, where she would be put in chains inside the house. Somehow, the woman managed to get her hands on the key and free herself. She returned to Surendranagar a second time just a week ago, the officer said. She started to live in the community with her lover and his extended family. But the accused persons found her again and informed the main accused in Vapi. They then took her to the place where the incident took place, and filmed her punishment as well, ASP Bihani said. Asked about the use of the section relating to gangrape, the officer said, Forcing someone to commit oral sex is considered rape in law. And since nine people were involved here, we have booked them for gangrape. Following the rescue of the woman from the house, the police also managed to locate the male victim her alleged lover in the video who had managed to escape from the locality. He remains under medical treatment, while the woman is currently in the protection of the state. Surendranagar Police have found the first wife of the main accused and their children living in Vapi. That is why we have not called the main accused the husband of the complainant woman, ASP Bihani said.

articleTitle: Karan Johar says ‘no cricketers’ amid demand for Virat Kohli on Koffee With Karan Season 9
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Despite huge fan demand for Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma, Karan Johar has confirmed that no cricketers will appear in Koffee With Karan Season 9.
description: Despite huge fan demand for Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma, Karan Johar has confirmed that no cricketers will feature as guests in Koffee With Karan Season 9.
body_raw: Ever since director-producer Karan Johar announced that he is all set to return with his widely popular chat show, Koffee With Karan, for the ninth and last time, social media has been abuzz with speculation about who all will show up as guests. Meanwhile, one section of netizens has been strongly demanding that power couple Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma be brought on as guests in one of the episodes. Unpacking Koffee With Karan Season 9s latest teaser Now, the producers of the show have unveiled a new teaser, categorically denying the presence of any cricketers this time. The clip features Karan speaking on the phone with various unnamed people, hinting at his plans for Koffee With Karan Season 9. Reiterating that this will be the final time he hosts the chat show, the director insists, Im not acting, Im not pretending this will be my last. Must Read Lost Rs 250 cr in 13 years Rajpal Yadav to SC, hints at film on cheque-bounce cases Karan then slips into his signature wit with, What? What do you mean it should have ended 10 years ago? How rude In conversation with another person, he says, Thank you for asking, but I havent invited you for eight seasons. So, I dont plan to invite you for the ninth either. Sorry, are you crying? Karan Johar puts end to Virat Kohli rumours Indirectly refuting speculations about Virat Kohlis presence on the show, he notes, Cricketers are not invited. Theyre also not coming. Theyre actually refusing. As the conversation continues, someone on the other side of the phone asks the director for the couch cushions as a gift. He wonders, Isnt that creepy? He then quips to someone else, I wont be calling her at all. God knows what else will come alive if she comes. Next, he is shown speaking to his mother, who worries he is being sacked from Koffee With Karan. No, Mumma, theyre not cutting my money. Its my decision to end the show. I will buy you that diamond, I promise, he tells her. Teasing what to expect from the show this time, he assures someone, You can manifest a relationship. But no, it doesnt help with divorce. Although Karan maintains that this season will be controversy-free, he ends the promotional video with a wink, suggesting he will wrap up his beloved chat show with a bang. ICYMI Salman Khan hosts BJP youth leader at Mumbai home Touched by your warmth, simplicity While Virat Kohli has never been on the show, Anushka Sharma has appeared three times. She made her Koffee With Karan debut in 2011 during Season 3, alongside her Band Baaja Baaraat 2010 and Ladies vs Ricky Bahl 2011 co-star Ranveer Singh. She made her comeback the very next season, sharing the floor with veteran director Anurag Kashyap. Anushka Sharmas last Koffee With Karan appearance was in December 2016, when she arrived on Season 5 of the show with her Jab Tak Hai Jaan 2012 co-star Katrina Kaif. Why Karan Johar avoids inviting cricketers now In a conversation with Sania Mirza on her podcast last year, Karan had admitted that hes never actually invited Virat to be on the show. I have never asked Virat. And now, I am not asking any cricketers after what happened with Hardik Pandya and KL Rahul. There are many who I just felt wouldnt come, so I never asked them in the first place, he said. Karan had previously hosted KL Rahul and Hardik Pandya on the show, and Pandyas comments during the episode recieved a lot of flak. Both players also faced a suspension by BCCI. articleTitle: Bihar court convicts police officer of contempt for flouting orders, fines him Re 1
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Rohtas court ias ips training bihar sp police officer dig contempt case kidnapping
description: The court observed that the Superintendent of Police, Rohtas, had habitually, deliberately and intentionally failed to comply with court orders, despite being given repeated opportunities.
body_raw: A Bihar court has found a senior police official guilty of contempt for flouting its orders and slapped a symbolic Re 1 fine. The court also directed the Ministry of Personnel and Training to overhaul the training system for IAS and IPS officers in alignment with the democratic system. Additional Sessions Court Judge Anil Kumar had iniciated contempet proceeding against the then SP Rohtas, Raushan Kumar, on August 17, under the provision concerning wilful disobedience of court orders, after observing that the SP had failed to comply with its directions and had not responded to a show-cause notice. Criticising his conduct, the court directed the fines recovery from his salary and ordered that the conviction be entered in his service record. The opposite party has not only failed to comply with the court orders habitually, deliberately and intentionally but also tried to overawe and overpower the court by approaching several eminent persons. His antecedent conduct as well as conduct during trial, especially not appearing for his evidence, shows his haughty, arrogant and egoistic attitude and thereby deprives him of any sympathy of this court, the court observed while convicting the then Rohtas SP. Directing its office to send a copy to the Ministry of Personnel and Training to draw attention to the need to overhaul the training system for IAS and IPS officers so that it is aligned with the democratic system, the order said, This problem is not confined to Bihar only. In an execution matter, Namakkal Tamil Nadu D.M. was sent several orders, including show-cause notices, but he did not reply even once. Then, the petitioner was asked to withdraw it and approach the Madras High Court under Article 227 of the Constitution of India. He did the same. Unconditional apology of DM, Namakkal sent to this court. Drawing reference from various instances and pointing out serious flaws in the training of such IPS officers, Justice Anil Kumar said, Even this court has no good experience with IAS officers, especially district magistrates. In the Periyamal Case, the Supreme Court directed that execution cases must be disposed of within six months. Noting that even after the issuance of notices and disciplinary action recommendation against the then Rohtas SP, the court said, Till date, neither the DGP nor the chief secretary sent even a single chit of paper This shows the apathy, indifference and respect of the Bihar Administration for the District Court While initiating the contempt proceedings, the court remarked, As the court found the whole administration unresponsive, it was compelled to launch a proceeding for wilfully disobeying the court orders, lowering the dignity of the court and flouting the majesty of law. The court highlighted that, on the states request, four dates were given, i.e., on August 28, September 7, September 11, September 14, and September 22, but he did not appear to give his evidence. Rather, he used this time to pressurise the court to drop the proceedings by approaching an eminent person. A kidnapping case and order to SP The court made these observations while dealing with a case related to kidnapping. The Rohtas District Court had convicted the 10 persons, noting that even when the victim and his complainant son turned hostile. The court had subsequently directed the then Superintendent of Police, Rohtas, Raushan Kumar, to obtain the accused persons latest criminal antecedents, register an FIR and initiate action against the victim for alleged perjury. According to the court, the victim was allegedly kidnapped for a ransom of Rs 1.5 crore and had then turned hostile after allegedly receiving Rs 20 lakh. The court also directed an inquiry into the victim and his son after evidence suggested their involvement in illegal activities. During the trial of the Session Case, it has come on record that the victim was involved in the business of Ganja Cannabis and became rags to riches from that illegal business, it said. It added that just before the incident of kidnapping, his informant-son won one crore rupees in gambling before the Diwali Puja, which was cited as the immediate reason for his fathers kidnapping. Expressing displeasure, the court said that the then SP did not realise the urgency and submitted the report a month after the disposal of the case that, too, was merely a formality because his report was just copied from the case diary. No recent criminal antecedents were provided. The court later found that the SP had failed to comply with these directions and did not respond to a show-cause notice issued in July. It therefore initiated contempt proceedings, alleging wilful disobedience of court orders and conduct lowering the dignity of the court.

articleTitle: Flydubai Omani co-pilot trained in UK, New Zealand, Australia: How Hamam al-Hammami slipped through aviation safety nets
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Flydubai Dubai-Tel Aviv Flight News
description: The Omani co-pilot, identified as Hamam al-Hammami, 29, is believed to have attended one of the UK’s biggest flight schools between 2018 and 2019.
body_raw: Flydubai flight FZ1073s Omani co-pilot, who allegedly stabbed Indian captain Smit Machchhar in a midair cockpit brawl last week in an apparent attempt to crash the Dubai-Tel Aviv plane, reportedly trained to become a professional pilot in Britain. The Omani co-pilot, identified as Hamam al-Hammami, 29, is believed to have attended one of the UKs biggest flight schools between 2018 and 2019, The Telegraph reported. The report added that Hammami received the training from England-based L3 Airline Academy, a pilot training firm that is a part of Acron Aviation. Acron Aviation declined to say whether Hammami had trained with the company, citing its policy of not publicly commenting on individual current or former students. The company said it would assist authorities with any investigation. Crash axe attack on Indian pilot The Omani co-pilot, who attacked Machchhar with a crash axe that is usually kept in the cockpit in case of emergencies, reportedly trained at one or more centres of L3 Airline Academy in England, which includes major training facilities in Southampton and Bournemouth, as well as a simulator centre near Gatwick. Israeli passenger Yaniv Hayoun, with blood stains on his shirt, who was aboard a Flydubai aircraft that made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, is welcomed at the arrivals gate at Ben Gurion International Airport near Tel Aviv, Israel. AP Photo The co-pilot of flydubai flight FZ1073, which had been bound for Israel from Dubai, attacked the pilot with an emergency crash axe, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general has said, calling the incident a terrorist attack. Co-pilots New Zealand training stint The co-pilot was in New Zealand from November 2018 to May 2019 on a six-month student visa, according to New Zealand Police. Police said he was there to complete part of his flight training for a UK-based company that no longer operates in New Zealand. Australia links investigated The Victorian Joint Counter Terrorism Team, comprising the Australian Federal Police, Victoria Police and the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation ASIO, is investigating the mans links to Australia, the Australian Federal Police said. Melbourne University connection Reuters, citing sources, reported that the co-pilot had studied at RMIT University in Melbourne. RMIT separately confirmed that a former student alleged to be involved in the Flydubai incident had been enrolled at the university but did not complete an engineering qualification. The university did not identify the former student.

articleTitle: Gukesh’s coach Gajewski: ‘Good for him to be reminded he can play really well’
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Gukesh
description: Chess-wise the recent Olympiad was 'good' not 'great' for Gukesh but mentally he was strong, which is a good thing, says his coach Grzegorz Gajewski
body_raw: One of Indian chesss biggest positives at the recent Chess Olympiad was the uptick in form of world champion D Gukesh, who had seven wins and three draws in the first 10 rounds at a staggering performance rating of 2,797, before he lost his final round clash with Hungarian GM Gleb Dudin. The tournament was likely the world champions last appearance in an over-the-board tournament before he hunkers down to prepare for his upcoming World Chess Championship battle against the Uzbek challenger Javokhir Sindarov. For Gukesh, the Olympiad proved to be a slump-buster. Since he has become the world champion in December 2024, hes not won a tournament, coming close at the Tata Steel tournament in Wijk aan Zee in January 2025 and then the Norway Chess tournament that same year. But in recent tournaments, his form has dwindled, at Norway Chess in 2026, he was last in the six-player field, while at the Chennai Grand Masters, he did not taste victory in a single game. These Olympiad results are definitely good for the confidence, its good for Gukesh to be reminded that he can play really well, Gukeshs coach, Polish grandmaster Grzegorz Gajewski, tells The Indian Express in an interview. Before the tournament began, there was some criticism about Gukesh playing on Board 4 for India with Praggnanandhaa on Board 1, Arjun Erigaisi on Board 2 and Nihal Sarin on Board 3. In the previous two Olympiads, Gukesh had excelled on Board 1. Later, Gukesh had revealed that it was his call to play on the fourth board, which in hindsight looks like a masterstroke. I wouldnt call it this way a masterstroke. His teammates performed better in some of the previous events and they were also higher rated so it just seemed like the right thing to do, says Gajewski. Ask Gajewski for his assessment of Gukeshs form at the recent Olympiad, and he says Chess-wise the Olympiad was good but not great. Gukesh can definitely do better. Mentally he was strong and thats the most important thing right now. Chess-wise the recent Olympiad was good not great for Gukesh but mentally he was strong, which is a good thing, says his coach Grzegorz Gajewski The world also saw a different side of Gukesh at the Olympiad. A much easy-going side. He made jokes with the rest of the team. He posted a hilarious video with Praggnanandhaa about a fan mistaking the both of them. He was even at the Bermuda Party an Olympiad tradition where players from all nations come together for an evening party just before the only rest day of the tournament despite the Indians having lost to Uzbekistan that day, a result which more or less ascertained that the Indians would not be able to defend gold. Ask Gajewski whats changed about Gukesh, and he replies For sure his routines during the Olympiad werent as strict as they used to be and I think its a positive thing. The last year was really difficult for Gukesh and in general achieving so much comes with a price. I think that he managed to figure it out and indeed he seems really happy now

articleTitle: Account aggregator ‘interoperability’: What RBI’s move means for your asset statement
articleFeaturedImageAlt: RBI investments
description: Account aggregators are NBFCs that act as a secure bridge for banking data, allowing lenders to access all relevant data swiftly for faster loan disbursements, or manage consent for other companies attempting to fetch your data.
body_raw: Dematerialised accounts have made it easy for investors to track their investments across financial markets, be it stocks, mutual funds, debt instruments, or commodities. This has made investing quite hassle-free for the common man, eliminating the need to track statements through different apps or depositories. The Reserve Bank of Indias RBI move to now allow interoperability between financial account aggregators AAs could also get your bank holdings into the singular consolidated statement, eliminating the need to track different bank statements to keep a check on deposits. The central bank on Wednesday October 7 allowed interoperability among NBFC Account aggregators, enabling aggregation of financial information through all account aggregators from one account aggregator. What RBI said about account aggregators After the monetary policy statement, Governor Sanjay Malhotra said, We are also facilitating SEBI regulated depositories to include information related to deposit accounts in their consolidated account statement CAS. The measures will be implemented by December 31, 2026. Account aggregators are non-banking financial companies NBFCs who store and move the users banking data without having the permission to access it. They act as a secure bridge for banking data, allowing lenders to access all relevant data swiftly for faster loan disbursements, or manage consent for other companies attempting to fetch your data. The account aggregators are basically people with whom banks enter into a contract for the purpose of sharing information. You can basically get onboarded as a bank customer, consenting to provide your information. And on the basis of your information, they will be able to pull data, explained Vivek Iyer, Partner and National Leader for Financial Services at Grant Thornton Bharat. What changes for you Currently, a consolidated account statement gives an overview for either your banking assets such as deposits, or for demat holdings like stocks, mutual funds, and bonds. There are around 17 account aggregators registered under the RBIs NBFC-AA categorisation, each separately operating in these two spaces. With the RBI opening the door for interoperability between these aggregators, investors will now get a single CAS capturing fixed deposits, recurring deposits, mutual funds, and all other financial instruments regulated by the RBI and the Securities and Exchange Board of India SEBI. This will simplify tracking investments for an average investor. The bottomline, thus, is a comprehensive overview of all investments across the banking and financial markets. On the banking side, this consolidated overview will only be limited to the assets you hold like deposits, and not your loans. Currently, they account aggregators do not have permission to view bank deposits. Why? Because bank deposits sit under banking, the regulator for whom is RBI. And depositories sit under SEBI. So, what RBI has done with this reform is they have spoken to SEBI and told them that this is the reform we will implement. I will handle the aggregators from the banking end, you handle them from the depositories end, explained Iyer. This interoperability may also help smaller businesses that need loans, which are hampered by the lack of standardisation of information across different AAs. A more interoperable AA ecosystem can materially reduce this friction by enabling consent-based access to verified financial data and making the underwriting process faster and more efficient, according to Varoon Naidu, Co-founder of Capital Stack. This can be particularly meaningful for MSMEs and smaller businesses. Better access to banking and other financial data can allow lenders to assess actual cash flows and financial behaviour rather than relying predominantly on traditional bureau scores, collateral or borrower-submitted information. Over time, this should improve both the availability and quality of credit, reduce turnaround times and potentially allow lenders to price risk more accurately, said Naidu. Further scope for interoperability While the central bank has taken initial steps towards a comprehensive asset overview for each person with the announcement on Wednesday, there is further scope going ahead. For example, the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India IRDAI could also come on board so that an individuals CAS also reflects the insurance policies they hold. This can be done through cooperation between the RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI. See, for that, the insurance market needs to be matured. So, one step at a time. They SEBI and RBI said let us just first integrate the bank deposits with the investments. And then we can get into the whole insurance aspects also. At some point in time, you will see an integration of your insurance also coming into it, said Iyer. So, the goal is basically a single comprehensive list of assets held by each investor. And the RBIs permission for interoperability between AAs marks an important step towards achieving this.

articleTitle: Tracing Uttarakhand’s 8.27 lakh ‘missing’ voters: What EC’s camps, house visits will check
articleFeaturedImageAlt: The exercise, details of which were presented to all district election officers this week, will begin with three-day camps at all 12,543 polling stations from October 8 to 10, followed by house-to-house verification between October 12 and 20.
description: Days after the final rolls were published, the Election Commission of India will trace voters missing from the final roll, verify their status and enrol eligible electors through Form 6
body_raw: The Election Commission has launched a special drive to trace and verify 8.27 lakh electors who were marked ASDD uncollectible during Uttarakhands Special Intensive Revision SIR, with officials now being instructed to identify those whose names figured in the pre-SIR electoral roll but are missing from the final list. The exercise, details of which were presented to all district election officers this week, will begin with three-day camps at all 12,543 polling stations from October 8 to 10, followed by house-to-house verification between October 12 and 20. The drive is aimed at correcting omissions after the SIR rather than undertaking another revision officials will specifically trace people who were on the pre-SIR roll, verify their current status and enrol them through Form 6 if they remain eligible. The data presented by the Chief Electoral Officers office shows that 8,26,977 electors were marked ASDD during the SIR. The highest number was recorded in Dehradun 1,86,008, followed by Udham Singh Nagar 1,77,673, Haridwar 1,30,203, Almora 55,485, Pauri Garhwal 51,359 and Tehri Garhwal 43,625. The development comes days after Uttarakhand published its final electoral roll on October 3, with 71,58,949 electors - around 8 lakh fewer than the electorate before the SIR. Chief Electoral Officer BVRC Purushottam said Wednesday that the exercise would specifically look for people who were on the pre-SIR roll but are absent from the current roll. BLOs shall compare the current electoral roll with the pre-SIR electoral roll and identify such electors whose names were there in the pre-SIR roll but who are not included in the current electoral roll and prepare a list of such electors. House-to-house verification Following the three-day camps, BLOs will visit the homes of identified electors between October 12 and 20 to ascertain their present status and facilitate enrolment through Form 6 wherever they are found eligible. The exercise will also cover other left-out voters and first-time voters who became eligible with reference to October 1, 2026. Purushottam said the BLOs would also assist those who turned 18 on October 1 in filling Form 6, and that the exercise will involve not just election officials but also representatives of political parties. During the three-day camps, BLOs, Booth Awareness Group BAG members and Booth Level Agents BLA-2 will be present at polling stations. During house-to-house visits, BLOs will be accompanied by BAG members and, as far as possible, BLAs. The lists prepared by BLOs will be shared with BLAs of recognised political parties. At the end of the exercise, Electoral Registration Officers will again share booth-wise lists with political party representatives, giving them another opportunity to identify eligible voters left out of the roll. 8 lakh-plus drop after SIR The fresh exercise assumes significance against the scale of deletions during the revision. According to data by the CEOs office, Uttarakhand had 84,29,459 electors on the January 6, 2025 roll. Between January 2025 and August 13, 2026, there were 4,01,276 additions but 17,05,130 deletions across the revision process. The final roll published on October 3 contained 71,58,949 electors. During the claims-and-objections period between July 14 and August 13, 1,29,872 additions and 1,04,708 deletions were recorded. The Indian Express had earlier reported that 1,30,382 Form-7 applications seeking deletion of names were filed during the claims-and-objections period, with more than 85 percent of these coming from Udham Singh Nagar, Haridwar, Dehradun and Nainital. The Electoral Registration Officers will process the applications under the Representation of the People Act, 1950 and Registration of Electors Rules, 1960. The presentation also draws their attention to Rule 20, which provides for a summary inquiry into claims and objections and an opportunity for the concerned persons to be heard.

articleTitle: Hamas calculus, Israel’s gamble: How October 7 reshaped the region, 3 years on
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Hamas
description: Why did Hamas plan the attack, and three years later, where do Israel and Palestine stand? An Expert Explains.
body_raw: On October 7, 2023, a Hamas-led attack in Israel killed around 1,200 people, while 251 were taken hostage. Israels response in the three years since has utterly devasted Gaza and sparked off three other linked wars in Iran, Lebanon, and Yemen. Why did Hamas plan the attack, and three years later, where do Israel and Palestine stand? The Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 UN investigations detail that the complex attack comprised an assault from the land, sea, and air in conjunction with the launch of a large-scale rocket and mortar attack towards cities, towns and villages and military bases in southern and central Israel. Executed across the day, the October 7 operation also saw attacks on several Israeli kibbutzim and the Nova music festival, assaults on Israeli beaches and arterial roads, and triggered the evacuation of nearly 150,000 people from their homes. Three years since, all Hamas-held hostages both dead and alive have been released, with the last batch of releases occurring as a result of a US-induced January 2025 ceasefire. On the other hand, Israels continuing military offensive in Gaza since October 2023 has killed over 70,000 Palestinians by conservative estimates, with Israeli actions characterised as a genocide by several states and human rights agencies, as well as a UN Commission of Inquiry. Israel is presently headed into its first elections since the attack, with the countrys longest-serving PM, Benjamin Netanyahu, seeking yet another term. What was Hamas strategic logic for October 7? Hamas October 7 attack occurred when it did as a result of two specific strategic conditions. First, in the 15 years before October 2023, Israels security calculus vis-a-vis Hamas had settled into a quiet for quiet approach. Besides the broader strategic goal of repelling Israeli occupation, Hamas own focus with Israel prioritised sub-strategic goals such as the lifting of Israels stringent economic blockade on Gaza since 2007 and the release of over 5000 Palestinian prisoners in Israel. There were new unwritten rules of the game in both IDF and Hamas parlance, which would be determined by acceptable and unacceptable acts. Moreover, Hamas own ability to deter a large Israeli offensive in Gaza had been proven by its intense exchanges of rocket fire most prominently for 51 days in 2014. By 2018, Hamas abilities to threaten hinterland Israeli targets had grown sufficiently for its leader Yahya Sinwar to assert that whatever rockets hit Tel Aviv for 51 days in 2024, would be launched within five minutes if Israel carried out any offensive. Since 2018, Israel had also let conditional aid trickle into Gaza as a result of negotiations with Hamas through Egypt, further contributing to Hamas perceptions of a vindication of its posture. This balance was sustained by an Israeli political interest in playing off Hamas against Fatah in the West Bank especially under Netanyahu, who fiercely defended allowing Qatari financial sustainment of Hamas across 2019 and 2020 as necessary to prevent the creation of a Palestinian state. Even hard-right politicians such as Bezalel Smotrich presently Israels Finance Minister and West Bank administrator argued in 2015 that Hamas is an asset, and Abu Mazen Mahmoud Abbas of Fatah is a burden. Second, Israels approach to removing the possibility of a Palestinian state alongside an expansion of its settlement project in the West Bank had taken on a regional character especially since 2020. Both the Abraham Accords of that year as well as subsequent Arab signaling of a de-prioritisation of the Palestinian issue brought the fundamental logic of resistance back to Hamas. Hence, as far as six months before October 7, Hamas then second-in-command Saleh al-Arouri had publicly declared that Palestinians had between two to three years before Israeli settlers in the West Bank increased to two million, making a decisive, multi-front war necessary in the near term. A more specific window of opportunity was created due to Israels then ongoing domestic crisis featuring a tussle between the Netanyahu-led executive and the judiciary. This logic was supplemented by Hamas having increasingly integrated itself into Irans Axis of Resistance. But this architectures functioning was complicated. Irans Axis was built on a non-sectarian strategic logic but with deterrence and not war as the principal objective a regional threat-in-being to counter Israels own regional approach to countering Iran. It became categorically evident on October 7 that Hamas wrested agency from the rest of the Axis, most of whom were then faced with a now or never scenario to fulfill their long-standing objective of defeating the Israeli state. However, even as Hezbollah became the only principal Shia force that initiated rocketmissile exchanges following October 7, then Hezbollah Chief Hassan Nasrallah repeatedly rationalised a limited approach and the rest of the Axis remained hesitant to act until the Yemeni Houthi blockade in early 2024. Hence, immediately after the attack, Hamas returned to seeking sub-strategic concessions from Israel. Consequently, as the Qatari PM has stated on the record, Hamas was willing to release all hostages on the first day of the war. How did October 7 affect Israels security outlook? The October 7 attack dealt a huge dent to Benjamin Netanyahus image as Israels Mr Security. However, in retrospect its domestic political effects were more complicated. Israels security architecture was already working with a long-set outlook vis-a-vis Hamas that had been politically blessed by successive Israeli governments, including Netanyahus. However, Netanyahus domestic political crises and threats from the judiciary incentivised inaction before the attack despite warnings from both Egypt and UAE, while the attack itself necessitated aggressive action instead of accepting Hamas offer for hostage return. This latter posture was further supported by the hard-right lawmakers who propped up his government. Now, Netanyahus electoral gamble is that his post-October 7 aggressive regional approach has yielded successes that have been long necessary for Israeli security. This includes significant dents to Irans Axis Hezbollahs operational decimation in south Lebanon and northern Israels expanded security perimeter a longstanding Israeli priority Bashar al Assads fall in Damascus and a free rein for Israeli military operations in Syria, which has led to an expanded Israeli occupation of the Golan Heights a US war on Iran and Arab restraint in punitive actions against Israel. However, it is the continuity in regional conflict of which these successes are a part that has enabled his opponents to keep the focus on October 7s security failure. Nonetheless, the scale of regional shifts now means that beyond Netanyahu, there is a normalisation of an aggressive security posture. This is a security logic that combines past and future. Regardless of whether Netanyahu survives politically, this assertive outlook now arguably pervades Israels politico-security establishment at large, while Israel continues to resist international pressure against its continuing occupation and expansion of settlements in Palestinian territories.

articleTitle: Watch: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka hauled away again after lie-in on Delhi road
articleFeaturedImageAlt: The Congress leaders were detained by cops in dramatic circumstances
description: The showdown erupted after Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge hosted lunch for INDIA bloc MPs at a restaurant on Janpath, less than 2 km from the Jantar Mantar protest site.
body_raw: Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra were dragged away by Delhi Police Wednesday evening as opposition leaders launched Day 2 of their protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The Congress leaders were detained by cops in dramatic circumstances - Rahul Gandhi was manhandled and bundled into a police bus, the second time in as many days. An angry-looking Priyanka Gandhi, who lay on the road with her arms crossed, was hustled away minutes later. She held on to a copy of the Constitution, her arm outstretched outside the moving vehicle. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra were dragged away by Delhi Police-for a second time in as many days-after opposition MPs kick-started Day 2 of protests demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar quit over irregularities in the SIR process. Read - The Indian Express IndianExpress October 7, 2026 The showdown erupted after a lunch meet organised by Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge for INDIA bloc MPs. The venue was the all-vegetarian Sagar Ratna restaurant on Janpath, less than 2 km from the Jantar Mantar protest site. Earlier, Rahul Gandhi was trolled online by a section of X users for allegedly having a non-vegetarian roll from Khan Chacha eatery during his eight-hour sit-in at the Akashvani Bhawan on Tuesday. After about one-and-a-half hours, the MPs streamed out of the eatery and went and sat in three buses parked on Janpath Road and headed towards Jantar Mantar. Interestingly, the Samajwadi Party skipped the lunch meeting. Sources in the Congress said that most of their MPs had left Delhi by this morning and couldnt attend the meeting and the subsequent protest. The issue was discussed during the lunch meeting where most other INDIA bloc parties were in attendance. When Rahul spoke to reporters, he said that 45 FIRs had been lodged against him, but he considered them to be medals and wanted a 100 FIRs. Today, we feel that we will protest at Jantar Mantar, which is a designated protest site, and tell the country that for us Gyanesh Kumar is not a legitimate Election Commissioner.As I said yesterday, around 300 Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha MPs wanted to meet Election Commissioners, but they did not meet us. They told us that we cannot protest here Jantar Mantar, Gandhi said. Lunch over, the MPs were being ferried in buses to Jantar Mantar when the cops closed them down at Windsor Place, which is roughly 900 metres from the popular protest site. Some Congress leaders, including Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, Imran Masood, Imran Pratapgarhi, Deepender Hooda and Srinivas B V climbed the roof of the bus in which Kharge, Rahul and Priyanka were travelling, and waved the tricolour, as the procession crawled from Janpath to Jantar Mantar, bringing the high security area to a halt for the second day. An impromptu sit-in took place at the roundabout in front of the Shangri-La hotel. The police soon moved to detain the protesters who countered the security officials. Rahul kept resisting police attempts to put him inside a van for detention. The INDIA bloc leaders jostled with security personnel who tried to detain them and clear the area. The entire Windsor Place roundabout was jammed with buses, cars and Congress youth outfit workers. While he was taken away to the Barakhamba police station, Rahul released a video message, continuing to engage through his social media platforms, besides his on-ground presence. We are not going to stop protesting till Gyanesh Kumar resigns.This is a fight to protect the most sacred thing in this country.There is nothing that Narendra Modi and Amit Shah can do that will stop us, he wrote in a post on his X handle along with a video message. We are not going to stop protesting till Gyanesh Kumar resigns. This is a fight to protect the most sacred thing in this country. There is nothing that Narendra Modi and Amit Shah can do that will stop us. - Rahul Gandhi RahulGandhi October 7, 2026 Later, the Congress said, The bus in which Rahul Gandhi ji was being taken was punctured by Congresss Babbar lions near Agrasen ki Baoli. The leaders were then taken to a police station in central Delhi. In a video attached to an X post, Rahul Gandhi said that Prime Minister Modi, Amit Shah, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat and Gyanesh Kumar can do all this, but we are going to bring them to justice. My guarantee that all four of them will be brought to justice. This is all a panic reaction. This is all fear. They are going to be brought to justice, mark my words, he said. articleTitle: ‘Special camps’ for voters cut after recent demolitions: Delhi poll body chief
articleFeaturedImageAlt: SIR survey in Delhi's Sangam Vihar. (Express Photo by Gajendra Yadav)
description: Delhi election officials will hold special camps to help eligible voters left out after recent demolitions enroll in the electoral rolls during SIR.
body_raw: The Delhi Election Commission on Wednesday said it would ensure that no eligible elector is left out of the electoral roll. The commission said special camps would be organised to facilitate the enrolment of all eligible electors who have been left out of the rolls. Every eligible elector is added and no ineligible entries remain in the electoral roll, the statement issued by the Election Commission of Delhi said. With the objective of maximising the enrolment of young electors, special camps were organised at various colleges and universities across Delhi from October 7 and will continue till October 8, 2026, the statement said. Booth Level Officers BLOs present at the camps will guide students in filling out the forms, collect the completed forms and address their queries related to the Special Intensive Revision SIR of electoral rolls. As per the instructions issued by the Election Commission of India on October 1, a special drive is being conducted to enrol all eligible electors left out of the electoral rolls. BLOs will conduct house-to-house visits to identify eligible persons and facilitate their enrolment through Form 6, wherever applicable. Special camps will also be organised on October 9 and 11, 2026, at all polling station locations across the National Capital Territory of Delhi to enrol eligible electors left out of the rolls. articleTitle: Justice Jalan recuses himself from hearing Gymkhana Club’s plea against eviction
articleFeaturedImageAlt: Delhi Gymkhana Club (Image: Wikimedia Commons)
description: Delhi High Court Justice Prateek Jalan recused himself from the Delhi Gymkhana Club eviction case, citing concerns over his own judgement.
body_raw: Delhi High Court judge, Justice Prateek Jalan, on Wednesday recused himself from hearing a civil suit over the Centres proceedings against the Delhi Gymkhana Club for its eviction from the 27.3-acre premises on Safdarjung Road. I am going to recuse myself from this matter. I would be more comfortable if somebody else hears this, Justice Jalan orally remarked. There are matters where one does not trust ones own judgement. There is too much personal involved, he said without elaborating, reported PTI. Justice Jalan directed that the lawsuit by the Delhi Gymkhana Club Ltd Staff Welfare Association be listed before another bench on Friday. Several suits have been filed challenging a May 22 notice by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs MoHUA, initiating re-entry in the Club premises in the heart of Lutyens Delhi. The Centre, invoking Clause 4 of the perpetual lease deed that allows such re-entry by the government, had stated that the land is critically required for strengthening and securing of defence infrastructure and other vital public security purposes. In May, Justice Avneesh Jhingan had issued summons in the suit while refusing any interim relief by staying the governments proceedings against the Club. The government had assured the court that no eviction shall be undertaken at the Club without adhering to due process of law. Apart from seeking re-entry through the conditions of the lease deed, the Union government has also initiated eviction proceedings against the Club under the Public Premises Act.

articleTitle: ‘They have come for me’: Kashmiri filmmaker Arfat Sheikh ‘detained by ICE agents’ at US airport
articleFeaturedImageAlt: arafat sheikh
description: Arfat grew up in the Valley and moved to the US as a student in 2019. As per a campaign seeking his release, he filed for asylum in 2020 and has been living in Virginia.
body_raw: A Kashmiri-born filmmaker, Arfat Sheikh, has allegedly been detained by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement ICE agents in the United States. Sheikhs film, Saffron Kingdom, has won several awards at American film festivals, and his storytelling is widely acclaimed. In a statement, filmmaker Tara Dorabji, who was accompanying Sheikh, said they were travelling together from San Francisco International Airport to Dulles on September 24. When we landed at Dulles, I was sitting towards the back of the plane, and Arfat exited before me. As I got off the plane, I walked by Arfat, without realising that he had been pulled aside on the jetway. Dorabji says that Arfat called out to her, and as she turned around, he was surrounded by numerous men. Arfat said to me, Tara, Tara. This is ICE. They have come for me. The men were in plain clothes and not wearing any uniforms that indicated that they were federal agents. During the entire interaction, I never saw any of the men present a warrant or say why they were taking Arfat. They took Arfat Sheikh off the jetway onto the tarmac. He did not resist. I was shaking and could barely move, she claimed. Dorabji is an author and filmmaker. Her documentary film series on human rights defenders in Kashmir won awards at more than a dozen film festivals in Asia and the US. The two were on their way to Washington, DC, for the Art as Resistance event at Busboys and Poets. A campaign to free Arfat has been launched by friends and acquaintances. In her statement, Dorabji emphasised that Arfat dedicated his life to speaking truth and defending human rights He is one of the kindest and most courageous people I know. He came to the United States legally as a film student to share about the human rights atrocities in Kashmir. She also talked about his film, Saffron Kingdom, created as a form of collective memory and truth-telling to tell the story of his people. It is devastating that someone who spent years bringing stories of human rights violations in war-torn regions to international audiences is in ICE detention, facing the conditions Arfat has dedicated his life to end, she said. The 42-year-old filmmaker is the son of Ghulam Nabi Sheikh, a celebrated Kashmiri folk singer. Sheikh died in 2003 from falling off a train when he was travelling from Jammu to Delhi with his daughter. Over the years, the family has called the official version of the events surrounding his death into question. Arfat grew up in the Valley and moved to the US as a student in 2019. As per the campaign, he filed for asylum in 2020 and has been living in Alexandria, Virginia.

articleTitle: UPSC Essentials | Daily subject-wise quiz : Science and Technology MCQs on neutrino, pneumonic plague and more (Week 183)
articleFeaturedImageAlt: UPSC Essentials | Daily subject-wise quiz : Science and Technology
description: Are you preparing for UPSC CSE Prelims 2027? Check your progress and revise your topics through this quiz on Science and Technology.
body_raw: UPSC Essentialsbrings to you its initiative of subject-wise quizzes. These quizzes are designed to help you revise some of the most important topics from the static part of the syllabus. Attempt todays subject quiz onScience and Technologyto check your progress. As we mark the 3rd anniversary of the UPSC Essentials magazine, we thank our readers for being part of this journey. Your trust, feedback and continued support have shaped the magazine and encouraged us to keep improving with every edition. Click Here to read the UPSC Essentials magazine for September 2026. Share your views and suggestions in the comment box or write to us at manas.srivastavaindianexpress.com. QUESTION 1 With reference to the neutrino, consider the following statements 1. It is a subatomic particle with no electric charge and almost no mass. 2. Exploding stars can produce enormous numbers of neutrinos. Which of the statements given above isare correct? a 1 only b 2 only c Both 1 and 2 d Neither 1 nor 2 Relevance It covers the basic properties and astrophysical sources of neutrinos, an important topic in particle physics. It helps understand the role of neutrino observations in studying otherwise difficult-to-detect cosmic phenomena. Explanation - Francis Halzen has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin. - A neutrino is a subatomic particle with no electric charge and almost no mass. The Nobel Prize official release calls it the shyest particle in the universe, because it passes through matter almost without a trace. Every second, 65 billion neutrinos from the Sun pass through our bodies, and we do not notice. Hence, statement 1 is correct. - Neutrinos are produced in enormous numbers by the Sun, exploding stars, nuclear reactions and radioactive decay. The same processes also produce protons, but because protons carry electric charge, their paths change by the time scientists can study them. Neutrinos interact so little with the world around them that studying the particles can give scientists a window into the processes that created them. Hence, statement 2 is correct. Therefore, option c is the correct answer. QUESTION 2 The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 has been awarded for a the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. b the development of metalorganic frameworks. c the discovery and synthesis of quantum dots. d the development of asymmetric organocatalysis. Relevance The question covers a significant recent development in chemistry and scientific research, linked to the Nobel Prize. It tests awareness of recent Nobel Prize-winning scientific discoveries and their broader applications. Explanation - The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 has been awarded to Henri B Kagan and Kenso Soai for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. - The scientists work led to the creation of a way to produce more of one type of molecules and less of its mirror image in chemical reactions where the product was the same as the catalysis, the agent causing the reaction. - The Nobel Prizes official press release explains chiral molecules using the example of a lock and key. Imagine making a key for a lock, only to discover that your manufacturing process produces two keys that are mirror images of each other. They look almost identical, but only one fits the lock. The other may do nothing - or, in some cases, cause damage. Therefore, option a is the correct answer. QUESTION 3 With reference to the pneumonic plague, consider the following statements 1. The pneumonic plague is caused by bacteria. 2. Pneumonic plague is primarily transmitted through the bite of infected fleas, in the same manner as bubonic plague. Which of the statements given above isare correct? a 1 only b 2 only c Both 1 and 2 d Neither 1 nor 2 Relevance The question helps understand the causative agent and modes of transmission of different forms of plague. It tests the ability to distinguish between pneumonic and bubonic plague based on their transmission mechanisms. Explanation - Hundreds have been quarantined after a 28-year-old laboratory technician reportedly died of pneumonic plague in the Siberian region of Irkutsk in Russia, according to Moscow Times report. - The pneumonic plague is caused by bacteria. Pneumonic plague generally requires close exposure to respiratory droplets from an infected person, and person-to-person spread is much less common. Hence, statement 1 is correct. - Pneumonic plague is primarily acquired through inhalation of respiratory droplets from an infected person or animal with pneumonic plague. Flea bites are the principal route associated with bubonic plague, not primary pneumonic transmission. Hence, statement 2 is not correct. - Antibiotics are effective against plague bacteria when given promptly. Therefore, option a is the correct answer. QUESTION 4 Consider the following statements regarding TAPAS-1, recently launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket 1. It is a commercial thermal infrared imaging payload developed by an Indian private startup. 2. It was carried into Low Earth Orbit as part of the Transporter-18 rideshare mission. 3. It is designed primarily for weather forecasting and atmospheric monitoring. How many of the statements given above are correct? a Only one b Only two c All three d None Relevance The question links with Earth-observation technologies, thermal infrared imaging and satellite applications. It tests awareness of SpaceX rideshare missions, Low Earth Orbit and emerging space-based imaging capabilities. Explanation - Minutes after midnight in India on Thursday, a partially reusable Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. This was the second of three space launches completed by Elon Musks SpaceX in a 13-hour window on October 1, a remarkable third triple-header from the company in the last two and a half years. - Among the 130 payloads on the flight was TAPAS-1, Indias first commercial private thermal-imaging payload, developed by Ahmedabad-based space technology startup Satleo Labs. - The Thermal Access Platform for Analytics Solutions TAPAS is a thermal infrared camera developed over a period of about 12 months by Satleo, a company founded in Ahmedabad in 2023 by spacetech entrepreneur Shravan Singh Bhati, retired ISRO scientist Dr Ranendu Ghosh, and sales and business development strategist Urmil Bakhai. Hence, statement 1 is correct. - TAPAS-1 is a CubeSat-category payload, which are a class of cubical nanosatellites that typically measure 10 cm x 10 cm x 10 cm-roughly the size of a Rubiks Cube-and are built using modular units and commercial components that are acquired off the shelf. - LEOs can be at altitudes between 160 km and 2,000 km above the surface of the Earth, and TAPAS-1 has been injected into an orbit 500 km high, from where the satellite will capture high-resolution images of heat and temperature variations at locations across the planet. Hence, statement 2 is correct. - TAPAS-1 has been designed to capture changes in the heat emitted from the Earths surface in the form of images. This data can be analysed using artificial intelligence AI, Bhati, the CEO of Satleo, told The Indian Express. Hence, statement 3 is not correct. Therefore, option b is the correct answer. QUESTION 5 The LDCT low-dose computed tomography is used to determine a The presence of early-stage lung cancer b The functioning of the hearts electrical conduction system c The blood glucose level and insulin response d The bone mineral density and risk of osteoporosis Relevance The question covers the application of Low-Dose Computed Tomography LDCT in modern medical diagnosis and screening. It helps distinguish LDCT from other diagnostic techniques based on their medical applications. Explanation - Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer deaths in India. In 2024, it accounted for 10.9 of all cancer deaths, or 98,687 deaths, up from 75,031 in 2022, when it ranked fourth. - Between 2022 and 2024, new lung cancer cases increased from 81,748, or 5.8 of all cancer cases, to 1.12 lakh, or 7.2, taking it from fourth to third place in terms of incidence. Mortality, meanwhile, increased from 8.2 of all cancer deaths to 10.9, shows the latest data from Global Cancer Observatory, a cancer statistics platform maintained by the World Health Organisations International Agency for Research on Cancer IARC. - But lung cancer is a disease that is not usually screened for - and has no easy way to screen for - it is usually diagnosed when it has already spread. We have seen that 93 of all the lung cancer cases are diagnosed in advanced stages, said Dr Abhishek Shankar, who was one of the authors of a perspective on lung cancer screening published by the IARC in September. - When diagnosed in late stages, the likelihood of surviving five years with lung cancer is just 7 to 18. This can increase to 80 if the disease is detected in the first stage. LDCT low-dose computed tomography based lung cancer screening can reduce the mortality from lung cancer by treating the disease at an early stage. Therefore, option a is the correct answer.
